sections.changelog: v1.2.109: Corrects the remaining v1.2.108 review issues. CSS Studio is separated from large Studio modal sizing so its compact settings panel and editor sidecar stay side-by-side. CSS Recipes is explicitly centered at Studio width. Content Studio Edit in Studio now uses the correct in-module save handler. Media Studio collection context menus open at the click point, MV collections can be dragged from the row or handle, and detected folder-plugin collections show a read-only lock affordance. Builder Tools mounts the Structure shortcut rail to the Structure panel so it moves with the panel instead of jittering as a separate fixed element.
